init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for single GPU, multi-GPU, or SLURM multi-node jobs
init_signal_handler: register signal handlers to manage SLURM job preemption and time limit signals
sig_handler: handle SIGUSR1 signals by requeuing the SLURM job on the main process
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signals by logging and bypassing termination for graceful shutdown
review_slurm_module: review the slurm module functions for distributed training and signal handling setup
